en.title: Stone Stars City
en.eyebrow:
A GAUDÍ DAYDREAM
IN STONE & COLOUR
en.headline: Stone
en.dek: A little city where architecture reaches for the sky.
en.notes:
Honey-coloured spires.
Jewel-like windows.
A thousand little lights.
en.sceneCaption: THE ORCHARD OF STONE STARS / A SAGRADA FAMÍLIA REVERIE
en.footerLeft: IMAGINED IN MINIATURE. AN ILLUSTRATIVE CITY, NOT A SURVEY.
en.garden.title: The stone garden
en.garden.text: Sculpted spires rise above terracotta roofs in the last warmth of the afternoon.
en.facade.title: The rose window
en.facade.text: Jewel-like petals, golden spokes and layered stone arches reward a closer look.
en.crown.title: A forest of spires
en.crown.text: Slender stone ribs, colourful crowns and a golden star turn the skyline into a sculpted garden.
en.stars.title: Under the stars
en.stars.text: The spires hold the last light. Below, a thousand little windows keep the city glowing.
en.hint: Drag to orbit · Scroll to zoom · Click the basilica
en.hintTouch: Drag to orbit · Use + and − to zoom · Tap the basilica
en.sceneAria: Interactive 3D miniature city. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, press Enter for the landmark card.
en.webglMissing: This scene needs WebGL. Turn on hardware acceleration or try another browser.
en.cardText: A storybook homage to the Sagrada Família. Honey-coloured spires grow like stone trees, jewel windows glow, and fruit-tipped towers reach for a little starlight.

zh-CN.title: 石星之城
zh-CN.volume: 第 01 卷 / 巴塞罗那
zh-CN.eyebrow:
高迪式的白日梦
石头与色彩
zh-CN.headline: 石之
zh-CN.dek: 在这座小城里，建筑向天空伸展。
zh-CN.notes:
蜂蜜色的尖塔。
宝石般的花窗。
千万盏小小的灯。
zh-CN.sceneCaption: 石星果园 / 圣家堂的遐想
zh-CN.footerLeft: 想象中的微缩城市，示意而非测绘。
zh-CN.footerRight: 石星之城 — 24 秒的白日梦
zh-CN.garden.title: 石头花园
zh-CN.garden.text: 午后最后的暖光里，雕塑般的尖塔升起在陶瓦屋顶之上。
zh-CN.facade.title: 玫瑰花窗
zh-CN.facade.text: 宝石般的花瓣、金色辐条和层层石拱，值得凑近细看。
zh-CN.crown.title: 尖塔之林
zh-CN.crown.text: 纤细的石肋、彩色塔冠和一颗金星，把天际线变成一座雕塑花园。
zh-CN.stars.title: 星空之下
zh-CN.stars.text: 尖塔留住最后的光，下面千万扇小窗让整座城继续发亮。
zh-CN.dayNote: 浅色石材 / 晴朗天空
zh-CN.goldenNote: 暖色石头 / 柔和阴影
zh-CN.jewelNote: 玻璃 / 陶瓦 / 青绿
